vara-ka, m. groomsman;

 🞄-ay-i-tavya, fp. to be chosen, out of (ab.).

vāra-ya, cs. (√ 1. vṛ) present etc..
vár-as, n. breadth, expanse (RV.).
vāraṅga, m. handle (of a knife etc.).

varāḍi-rāga, m. a kind of rāga;
 🞄i-rāga, m. id..
varāṇasī, f. N. of a river.
vārāṇasī, f. N. of a city, Benares.

vara‿atisarga, m. bestowal of a 🞄boon;
 -ānanā, a. f. fair-faced.

vā́rāha, a. coming from or relating 🞄to the boar (varāha);
 made of pigʼs leather.
varā́hu, m. boar, hog (RV.).

vár-i-man, n. [√ 1. vṛ] expanse, 🞄broad space, wide tract (V.);
 -i-mán, m. id. 🞄(V.).

varivas-yá, den. P. grant free space, 🞄vouchsafe (RV.);
 wait upon, cherish, tend 🞄(C.): -māna, pr. pt. with ps. mg. cherished.
varivas-yā́, f. devotion, service, 🞄attendance.
varivo-dhā́, a. bestowing freedom 🞄(RV.).
varī-tṛ, m. [√ 2. vṛ] wooer (also 🞄used to future).

2. var-īyas, cpv. better, more excellent;
 🞄best, most excellent, of (g.).
varuḍa, m. a mixed caste.
varuṇ-ānī, f. Varuṇaʼs wife.

varuṇa‿ālaya, m. Varuṇaʼs abode, 🞄ocean;
 -āvāsa, m. id..
varuṇ-yâ, a. belonging to or coming 🞄from Varuṇa (V.).

var-ū-tṛ́, m. (V.) protector of (g.);
 🞄(várū) -trī, f. tutelary genius (V.).
varūth-yâ, a. protecting, sheltering 🞄(V.).

vár-eṇya, fp. [√ 2. vṛ] to be wished 🞄for, desirable;
 pre-eminent, most excellent, 🞄chief, of (g.): -kratu, a. (V.) of excellent 🞄might or wisdom.
vara‿uru, a. (ū̆) having beautiful 🞄thighs.
varc-ín, m. N. of a demon combatted 🞄by Indra.
vārṇa, a. [varṇa] relating to a sound 🞄or letter (in the grammatical sense).

varṇay-itavya, fp. to be described;
 🞄-itṛ, m. describer.
varṇ-ita-vat, pp. act. (he) related, 🞄depicted, etc..
varṇa‿udaka, n. coloured water.

varṇ-ya, 〈1.〉 a. productive of colour;
 🞄〈2.〉 fp. to be described.
varta-ka, m. quail.
vārttā-ka, m., ī, f. (rare) egg-plant.
vart-anīya, fp. n. one should apply 🞄oneself or attend to (lc.).
vart-aya, cs. (√ vṛt) subsist, etc.
vārtta-ya, den. P. converse with (ac.).
vár-tave, d. inf. (of √ 1. vṛ) to cover 🞄(RV.).
vartavya, fp. incorr. for vartitavya.
vart-ī, f., v. varti.
vart-i-tva, n. treatment as of (—˚).
vart-ís, n. (turning in), lodging, abode 🞄(RV.).

vart-ula, a. [√ vṛt, turn], round;
 n. 🞄circle.

vartma-pāta, m. coming into the 🞄way;
 -pātana, n. waylaying.

var-tra, a. [√ 1. vṛ] warding off (S.);
 🞄dam, embankment (V.).

várdh-a, a. [√ 1. vṛdh] increasing, gladdening 🞄(—˚);
 m. granting of prosperity (RV.¹).

2. vardh-ana, n. [√ 2. vṛdh] cutting 🞄off (—˚);
 —˚ with names of towns prob. = town 🞄(rare): -svāmin, m. N. of a temple or statue.

vardh-anīya, fp. [√ 1. vṛdh] to be 🞄increased;
 to be caused to thrive.
vardhamāna‿īśa, m. N. of a temple 🞄or statue.

vardh-aya, cs. (√ 1. vṛdh) increase;
 🞄-ayitṛ, m. educator, rearer of (—˚): trī, f..

vardhāp-aya, cs. P. 〈1.〉 congratulate;
 🞄〈2.〉 cut (the umbilical cord).
vardh-ra, n. strap, thong (= varatrā).
varma-ya, den. P. provide with a 🞄coat of mail: pp. varmita, armoured.
varma-hara, a. (old enough for) 🞄wearing armour.
varmi, m. kind of fish: -matsya, m. the 🞄varmi fish.

varm-ita, pp. (of varmaya);
 -in, a. 🞄armoured.

vár-ya, fp. to be chosen, eligible (f.);
 🞄excellent, best, chief of (g., —˚).
var-var-aka, m. N. (less correct for 🞄barbaraka).
vārṣá, a. (ī́) belonging to the rainy 🞄season (varṣā).
varṣ-aya, cs. of √ vṛṣ.

varṣa‿upala, m. hail;
 -ogha, m. 🞄torrent of rain.

1. varṣ-mán, m. (V.) height, top;
 🞄crown of the head.
várṣ-ya (YV., or -yâ, RV.), a. rainy.

vāra-kanya-kā, f. (girl taken in 🞄turn), courtezan.

vārī, f., v. 2. vāri.
vārī-ya, den. Ā. resemble water.
vā́ruṇ-i, m. pat. (fr. Varuṇa) of 🞄various men.

 wooden.
vārtamān-ika, a. relating to 🞄the present (vartamāna), now living.

vā́rtraghna, a. (ī) relating to the 🞄slayer of Vṛtra (Vṛtra-han): with havis, n. 🞄= sacrifice for victory;
 m. pat. of Arjuna 🞄(regarded as a son of Indra).

 n. old age: -ṃ dhā, grow old: -bhāva, 🞄m. old age.

vār-dhi, m. (receptacle of waters), 🞄ocean.

vārdhrī, f. leather thong.
vār-muc, m. rain-cloud.
vār-vāha, m. rain-cloud.
vārṣa-parvaṇa, a. derived from 🞄Vṛṣa-parvan.

vārṣākap-a, a. having the nature 🞄of Vṛṣākapi.
vā́rṣṇa, (or á), m. pat. N..

 N. of Nalaʼs charioteer: (a)- 🞄sahita, pp. accompanied by Vārṣṇeya.
